RE-FREEZE 15-08-2026 (P6.9/P6.10, keputusan user): params produksi di-switch ke P6 (correctness fix - split lama position-based/leaky); M1 di-re-evaluate di atas layer baru -> M1 = previous_close h1-21 SEMULA, DIREVISI jadi h1/3/5 (h10/h21 veto Case C saturation p_min; h42/63 M0; prior_peak M0 semua h). m1_candidate.note: RE-FREEZE 15-08-2026 pasca-switch params P6. M1 lama (P4.7: c 0.8409/0.7065/0.7520/0.7033/0.8744 utk h1-21) INVALID: diturunkan dari probability layer pre-P6. M1 baru hanya utk h1/3/5 (Brier turun, O/E ~0.95, sat68 tetap ~0). h10/h21 DIBATALKAN: Case C - recalibration membuat p_min 0.68 jenuh (h10 sat68 1.7%->30.5%, h21 sat68 0%->100%: gate kehilangan seleksi total; konsisten acceptance_rules.overall). h42/63 M0 (M1 memperburuk Brier). prior_peak: M0 P6 raw utk SEMUA h (intercept recalibration tidak membantu; temuan kalibrasi temporal h42-63 O/E 0.59-0.64, slope VAL 1.36-1.55 - masalah slope bukan intercept).

frozen_base_rate_reference.note: Climatology DEV (data <= 2026-01-23, purged). DILARANG memakai prevalence holdout sebagai reference.

holdout_split.cutoff: ARGUMEN SAAT RUN (--cutoff YYYY-MM-DD): tanggal mulai data genuinely unseen
holdout_split.purge: observasi dipakai hanya jika date_s + h <= tanggal data terakhir (per horizon)
holdout_split.exclude: SEMUA observasi date_s < cutoff dibuang (tidak boleh tercampur)
holdout_split.note: holdout dibuka SEKALI (RUN ONCE); tidak boleh diulang dengan cutoff berbeda

probabilities.previous_close: empirical base rate + shrinkage beta-binomial (PIT), persis jalur produksi recovery._shrunk_rate, drop 5.0%
probabilities.prior_peak: logistic drawdown global recovery_model_params (PIT), dd=clip(1-close/peak, 0, 0.85), peak lookback 252
probabilities.regime: regime.regime_series (ADX14<20 sideways; close>SMA200 bull; else bear), PIT-safe per index observasi

metrics_probability_quality.calibration_intercept: fit logit(y) = a0 + a1*logit(p); intercept & slope + CI
metrics_probability_quality.reliability_curve: quantile bins (20) + smooth isotonic + identity + ECE10/ECE20 (diagnostic)
metrics_probability_quality.auc: roc_auc (harus identik M0 vs M1: transformasi monotonic)

ci.note: date-block = sumber uncertainty utama (time/regime variation, temuan P4.5)

metrics_operational_impact.target: previous_close h1-21 (M0 vs M1), gate p_min 0.68

acceptance_rules.note: Tidak ada angka magic tunggal; 8 aturan dari user, semua dievaluasi. INCONCLUSIVE bila n terlalu kecil atau CI terlalu lebar (bukan forced conclusion).
acceptance_rules.minimum_evidence_wording: PROJECT-SPECIFIC minimum evidence rule — BUKAN statistical universal minimum. Precision estimasi bergantung pada event prevalence, distribusi prediksi, lebar CI yang diinginkan, dan discrimination; tidak ada n=300 atau events=30 yang universal. Angka ini hanya safeguard operasional project.
acceptance_rules.decomposition_note: Brier decomposition (REL-RES+UNC) = DIAGNOSTIC hanya, BUKAN acceptance gate. Estimasi komponen finite-sample bisa biased (Ferro 2012). Metric utama: Brier, BSS, calibration slope/intercept, reliability curve.

rules.name: calibration_improvement_survives
rules.test: M1 O/E lebih dekat ke 1 daripada M0 (deviasi |log O/E| menurun)

rules.name: bss_not_deteriorate
rules.test: BSS_M1 >= BSS_M0 - 0.01 (margin 1pp, di bawah noise CI P4.5 +/-0.01-0.03)

rules.name: calibration_curve_improves
rules.test: ECE10_M1 <= ECE10_M0 DAN max|bin diff|_M1 <= max|bin diff|_M0

rules.name: operational_selectivity_acceptable
rules.test: POTENTIAL share (POTENTIAL/observasi) per h21 <= 0.50; flag bila gate kehilangan seleksi
rules.note: Ambang 0.50: gate dikatakan jenuh bila mayoritas populasi POTENTIAL. Nilai dapat direview user sebelum holdout dibuka.

rules.name: not_driven_by_one_stock_or_regime
rules.test: top-1 stock share POTENTIAL < 0.50; n_stocks_potential >= 10; setiap regime dengan n_events>=min_n punya >=1 POTENTIAL (regime tidak collapse)

acceptance_rules.overall: PROMOTE: semua rules PASS utk h bersangkutan; REJECT: ada FAIL; INCONCLUSIVE: tanpa FAIL tapi ada INCONCLUSIVE. PROMOTE M1 utk previous_close h1-21 HANYA bila semua h PASS.
acceptance_rules.final_verdict: M1 TIDAK boleh dipromosikan bila operational selectivity rusak (mis. POTENTIAL -> hampir semua saham), WALAUPUN Brier lebih baik. calibration != usefulness of decision threshold.

run_discipline: RUN ONCE: holdout dibuka satu kali dengan cutoff yang di-set sebelum melihat data
Tidak ada iterasi cutoff, tidak ada pemilihan metrik setelah melihat hasil
Output: data/phase4_holdout_report.json (probability quality + operational impact + verdict per rule)
Selftest (--selftest) memakai data DEV lama dan output-nya DITANDAI SELF_TEST - bukan bukti
